analysis_plan.unit: independent world; both record variants and all three arms remain paired
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 10000 whole-world resamples; descriptive unadjusted 95% percentile intervals
analysis_plan.format: score parseable final answers regardless of output-format compliance; no resampling
analysis_plan.invalid_answers: retain; per-contrast complete-world estimates and full-plan bounds
analysis_plan.interpretation: Cue-only requests no visible reasoning; this does not establish that hidden reasoning occurred. Pre-answer text presence does not establish reasoning quality or faithfulness. The visible-output contrast also changes the output requirement and cannot identify self-conditioning alone.
analysis_plan.decision: no scientific pass gate; no outcome-dependent extension

uncertainty: 10,000 whole-world bootstrap resamples, seed 981723; descriptive, unadjusted 95% intervals. The independent unit is the world, not an API call. Degenerate intervals do not establish certainty or equivalence. Full-plan unscorable bounds are point-estimate bounds, not confidence intervals.
interpretation: This fixed diagnostic compares prompt instructions and output requirements. The cue arm does not establish that hidden reasoning occurred; pre-answer text is not evidence of faithful internal reasoning. A cue-versus-visible difference does not uniquely identify self-conditioning. If contemporaneous direct-versus-visible harm is not reproduced, this run cannot locate the source of the earlier harm. No automatic scientific pass gate or sample extension is applied.
